title: Dangerous Goods Acceptance: light-consignment exemption from the surcharge
content:
## Rule
For the hazardous-cargo surcharge written at loading under the Dangerous Goods Acceptance product, the amount is 0.00 when the acceptance's gross weight is below the category's surcharge-free weight.

## Surcharge-free weight by category
| Category | Gross weight of the acceptance below which the surcharge is 0.00 (kg) |
|---|---|
| AHL DG Limited Quantity | 5000 |
| AHL DG Class 9 Standard | 0 |
| AHL DG Flammables and Corrosives | 0 |
| AHL DG Toxics and Oxidizers | 0 |
| AHL DG Compressed Gases | 0 |
| AHL DG Special Approval | 0 |

A figure of 0 means the surcharge is never free on account of weight.

## Boundary cases (AHL DG Limited Quantity, 5000 kg)
| Gross weight on the acceptance | Below 5000 kg | Surcharge |
|---|---|---|
| 4999.9 kg | yes | 0.00 |
| 5000.0 kg | no | computed in the ordinary way |
| 7200.0 kg | no | computed in the ordinary way |

## Points of judgement
- *Is the weight tested per container?* No; the test is on the acceptance's gross weight.
- *Can goods under AHL DG Class 9 Standard be exempt by weight?* No; its figure is 0, and no gross weight is below 0.
